$comment: Mapping from OpenCode modelIDs (as recorded in the OpenCode SQLite database)
native         - model exists verbatim in the EcoLogits registry
sibling        - model not registered, mapped to a registered model with the same
estimated-arch - model not registered; registered here as a custom model with a
best-known architecture guess (clearly flagged in reports)
Models absent from this file are reported as 'unmodeled' (token counts shown,
Provider note: EcoLogits only knows 6 providers (anthropic, mistralai, openai,
huggingface_hub, cohere, google_genai). Models reached through the cortecs
router or the Albert API are mapped to the mistralai provider config, which
supplies the datacenter PUE (1.16) and WUE (0.09 L/kWh) assumptions.
The electricity mix zone is set independently (see electricity_mix_zone).

glm-5.1.note: glm-5.1 not in EcoLogits; mapped to GLM-5 entry with identical registered architecture (MoE 744B total / 40B active)

glm-5.3-flash.note: Flash variant with no published architecture; assumed GLM-Air class (MoE 106B total / 12B active)

glm-4.7-flash.note: Flash variant with no published architecture; assumed GLM-Air class (MoE 106B total / 12B active)

devstral-2512.note: Devstral Medium class, dense 24B (served via cortecs)

qwen3-coder-30b.note: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct (MoE 30.5B total / 3.3B active), served on the Albert API (French infrastructure)

mistral-small-3.2-24b.note: Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct (dense 24B) as served on the Albert API; the EcoLogits 'mistral-small-2603' entry is a different (119B MoE) deployment

gpt-oss-120b.note: Open-weights GPT-OSS 120B (MoE 117B total / 5.1B active), served on the Albert API

claude-sonnet-4.note: Claude Sonnet 4 no longer in the EcoLogits registry; mapped to Sonnet 4.6 class (MoE 440B total / 44-132B active)
